justification: Image A depicts a stone stela with rows of hieroglyphic inscriptions and a lunette scene of standing human figures beneath a sun-disk with rays, while Image B depicts a boat with an upturned prow and stern and repeated oar-like or paddle marks, plus a few smaller abstract figures. There is no shared iconographic motif such as figures, script, or a sun-disk in B, nor any boat form in A, so the depicted content does not correspond beyond both being schematic line-based imagery on rock/stone surfaces.
